remedy_text: Boil 5-6 fresh Tulsi leaves and 1/2 tsp Mulethi (Licorice) powder in 2 cups of water until reduced to 1 cup. Strain and drink warm twice daily. Perform warm water gargles with a pinch of rock salt.
ayurvedic_note: Pacifies Kapha and Vata doshas, soothes mucosal lining.

remedy_text: Boil 1/2 tsp Cumin (Jeera) and 1/2 tsp Carom seeds (Ajwain) with a pinch of black salt in 250ml water for 5 minutes. Sip slowly after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Kindles Deepana (digestive fire) and relieves Vata entrapment.

remedy_text: Mix 1/4 tsp pure turmeric powder and 1/2 tsp Ashwagandha root powder in 1 cup of warm milk. Consume before sleep.
Mix 1 tsp fresh Vasa (Adhatoda vasica) leaf juice with 1 tsp raw organic honey. Take twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Potent bronchodilator and mucolytic herb native to Himalayan foothills.

remedy_text: Boil 2 gm dry ginger rhizome in water, reduce to one-fourth, and drink 10–20 ml twice daily. Ginger paste can also be applied on forehead for headache.
ayurvedic_note: Stimulates Agni (digestive fire), relieves Kapha-related congestion.

remedy_text: Take 1 gm Ajwain powder with black salt in buttermilk twice daily. For sinusitis, apply warm paste over forehead and inhale vapors.
ayurvedic_note: Relieves Vata imbalance, useful in digestive and respiratory complaints.

remedy_text: Consume 10–20 ml Amla juice daily. Apply paste of fruit rind on scalp to prevent hair fall and greying. Also useful for diabetes when combined with turmeric juice.
ayurvedic_note: Rasayana (rejuvenator), balances all three doshas, especially Pitta.

remedy_text: Boil handful of Tulsi leaves with 5 gm coriander seeds in water, reduce, and take 30 ml thrice daily for fever. Tulsi juice with honey relieves cough and cold.
ayurvedic_note: Sacred herb, balances Kapha and Vata, boosts immunity.

remedy_text: Take 2-3 gm of fine Haritaki fruit powder daily with seasonal adjuvants (Anupana): with Rock Salt (Saindhava) in Varsha/Monsoon, Sugar (Sita) in Sharad/Autumn, Ginger (Shunthi) in Hemanta/Early Winter, Long Pepper (Pippali) in Shishira/Late Winter, Honey (Madhu) in Vasanta/Spring, and Jaggery (Guda) in Grishma/Summer.
ayurvedic_note: Tridoshahara, Deepana, Medhya, Rasayana; preserves longevity and cleanses metabolic wastes (Mala shodhana).

remedy_text: Take 10–15 ml fresh stem juice or 30 ml decoction of Guduchi. Administer with Jaggery (Guda) for Vata & constipation, with Sugar (Sita) for Pitta disorders, with Honey (Madhu) for Kapha, with Castor Oil (Eranda Taila) for Vatarakta/Gout, and with Shunthi for Amavata (Rheumatoid arthritis).
ayurvedic_note: Tridoshashamaka, Vishaghna, Balya, Rasayana; eliminates Ama and cleanses blood.

remedy_text: Express 10–15 ml fresh juice from gently warmed Vasa leaves. Blend thoroughly with 5–10 ml raw honey. Consume 2–3 times daily after food.
ayurvedic_note: Tikta-Kashaya rasa, Sheeta virya; specifically alleviates Kapha-Pitta, Kasa, Shwasa, and Raktapitta.

remedy_text: Combine equal parts of Dry Ginger (Shunthi), Black Pepper (Maricha), and Long Pepper (Pippali). Take 1 to 2 gm of this blend mixed with 1 tsp honey before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Katu rasa, Ushna virya, Deepana, Pachana; scrapes away Kapha, clears respiratory channels, and kindles digestive fire.

remedy_text: Take 1–2 gm of powdered Panchakola (equal parts of Pippali, Pippalimoola, Chavya, Chitraka, and Nagara/Shunthi) with warm water or buttermilk twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Potent Deepana-Pachana formulation; eradicates Gulma, Shoola, Anaha, and Kapha-Vata blockage.

remedy_name: Shodhita Hingu with Ghee & Warm Water
remedy_text: Fry a pinch (approx. 125–250 mg) of pure Hing in cow's ghee until aromatic. Consume with the first morsel of warm food or mix in warm water with a pinch of rock salt.
ayurvedic_note: Tikshna, Ushna, Vata-Kaphanut; instantly normalizes Apana Vata and relieves colicky pain.

remedy_text: Boil 10 gm crushed Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) fruit in 200 ml water down to 50 ml. Cool slightly, add 1 tsp Mishri (unrefined sugar), and drink twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Madhura, Sheeta virya, Vasti-shodhana; soothes the urinary tract, eliminates Pitta-Vata burning, and acts as a mild diuretic.

condition_name: Burning Sensations, Internal Heat & Bilious Emesis
remedy_text: Soak 10-15 seeded dry grapes (Munakka) in 1 cup of boiled, cooled water overnight. Mash well in the morning, strain, and drink on an empty stomach.
ayurvedic_note: Madhura, Snigdha, Sheeta; immediately subdues aggravated Pitta, relieves Trishna (morbid thirst), and controls burning sensations.
source: Madanapāla Nighaṇṭu, Drākshādi Phala Varga, Sl. 2-5

remedy_text: Extract 30–50 ml fresh juice from peeled, raw Kushmanda fruit. Add a small pinch of powdered Yastimadhu or rock sugar. Consume early morning.
ayurvedic_note: Sheeta, Guru, Basti-shodhaka; powerfully cools systemic Pitta, nourishes tissues (Dhatu-vardhana), and pacifies Amlapitta.
source: Madanapāla Nighaṇṭu, Kushmāndādi Shāka Varga, Sl. 4-8

remedy_text: Boil 1 part roasted puffed paddy/rice (Laja) in 14 parts water until soft. Strain the supernatant liquid, add a pinch of Saindhava salt and roasted Jeera, and serve warm in small, frequent sips.
ayurvedic_note: Laghu, Grahi, Deepana, Dhatu-satmya; provides instant hydration and energy without overloading weak digestive fire.
